recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-10096.
issue_request: FHIR-10096 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for MedicationOrder.dispenseRequest.numberOfRepeatsAllowed. It said the definition counts additional refills/repeats while the comment implied total fills, and requested a corrected total-authorized-fills calculation of numberOfRepeatsAllowed plus one.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 8c9815efa4c991d85f683d7a156c4ed5ebece1d6 applied the issue by changing the comment from authorized refills subtract 1 to authorized fills add 1, and the source lineage later became MedicationRequest.
additional_context: FHIR-8143 established the additional-only repeat count; FHIR-13182 later added unsignedInt/zero-refill guidance and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-14565 later declined an element rename. No direct Zulip or Confluence reference for FHIR-10096 was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml already says to add 1 when displaying number of authorized fills and no stale subtract-1 comment was found in current source.

related_jiras.note: Established that numberOfRepeatsAllowed excludes the original dispense.
Changed the same element to unsignedInt and added zero-refill guidance; already represented on the combined branch.
Later Pharmacy no-change decision declined renaming numberOfRepeatsAllowed.
